newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FOREKS SURGES AFTER H1, FORECAST RAISED.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FOREKS SURGES AFTER H1, FORECAST RAISED.

text.p: Fourth largest bank Forekspan surged on Monday to end up eight kroons or 3.83 percent after it released first half group results and said it would increase its 1997 profit forecast, dealers said.
Forekspank had risen five percent last week while the whole market rose by 9.41 percent, pushed by key banking shares.
Dealers said Forekspank has more potential to rise as it is cheaper than leading banking shares Hansapank and Hoiupank , which have also seen record highs recently.
"It rises and falls slower than other stocks," one dealer said.
